\vspace{-0.5\baselineskip}\noindent\parbox{\textwidth}{\scriptsize Primary result and each sensitivity under the full multiple imputation (200 imputations, Rubin's rules, 95\% intervals in brackets). Every interval follows Rubin's rules within its own sensitivity; shares on the logit scale, H2 on the log scale. Dropping imputed answers does not recalibrate the weights. The 2025 advanced-meter shares change only that input; everything else stays at 2018. Daily digital access is commercial customers with daily access $\div$ commercial customers (EIA-861, 2018).\newline \textsuperscript{a} Status-tier share of floor area $\div$ share of buildings.\newline \textsuperscript{b} The diagnosis tier at the declared level.\newline \textsuperscript{c} Construction period minus building type in the Shapley R$^2$ decomposition. At or below zero, construction period explains no more of the variance than building type, which supports H3 without confirming it.}\par
